integrity: Full symbolic proof with independent finite-field multiplication matrix enumeration and cycle transfer checks; no external independent mathematical audit or certification.
scientific_limitations: Only the specified Artinian squarefree face algebra of a finite simple graph. The generic incidence-map fact and the bipartite condition have clear published antecedents. For arbitrary graphs the result is a finite support sum, not a claimed fast closed form. Literature coverage is incomplete and bibliographic priority cannot be fully guaranteed. Finite computations are corroboration, not an infinite proof.
title: Finite-field multiplication-rank spectra of graph face algebras
